name: qa-api-cripto
description: Testes de contrato, dados e desempenho de APIs públicas de cripto (Postman, Newman e k6)

scripts.test:api: newman run postman/qa-api-cripto.postman_collection.json -e postman/publico.postman_environment.json --delay-request 1500 --timeout-request 15000 -r cli,htmlextra,json --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/newman/index.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "QA API Cripto - Newman" --reporter-htmlextra-browserTitle "QA API Cripto - Newman" --reporter-json-export reports/newman/resultado.json
scripts.test:carga: mkdir -p reports/k6 && K6_WEB_DASHBOARD=true K6_WEB_DASHBOARD_EXPORT=reports/k6/carga-painel.html k6 run k6/carga.js
scripts.test: npm run test:api; npm run test:smoke && npm run test:carga; npm run painel
